build_gtn_package: build the gtn python package with cmake extensions for graph transducer networks
create_cmake_extension: create a CMakeExtension subclass to define a CMake-based setuptools extension without source files
run_cmake_build: run the CMakeBuild command to compile gtn native extensions using cmake version 3.5.1 or higher
load_readme_description: load the README.md file content to use as the long description for the gtn package
setup_gtn_bindings: setup the gtn package with seven CMake extensions including graph, autograd, utils, rand, creations, functions, and parallel modules
